title: Mars Rover Sets a New Driving Record
paragraphs: Perseverance is a robot car on Mars. It is from NASA. It came to Mars in 2021.
On 11 October 2026, it had a new record. It drove more than 45 kilometres on Mars. No car went this far on another world before.
The rover can find its way. It takes photos and makes a map. Then it drives on a safe road. It also takes small rocks for scientists.
